legend: "I was going with a "Do", but I think you guys are going for a "Tak"" said Teemo.
Teemo and Omda are playing Do and Tak Game.
The rules of Do and Tak are simple. Just stand in a circle and …$$$\dots$$$ Oh wait wrong game.
Initially, We have N×K$$$N \times K$$$ chips. A player can make one of two moves :
Use a Do, i.e remove K$$$K$$$ chips. You can only use a Do if the current number of chips is ≥K$$$\ge K$$$
Use a Tak, i.e remove 1$$$1$$$ chip.
The one who removes all chips first wins. If Omda starts playing, can you figure out who will win this game?
input: The first line contains the number of test cases T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤105)$$$(1 \leq T \leq 10^5)$$$.
